decision.title: A workflow publishes the JavaScript package on each release tag (owner)
decision.summary: Pushing a release tag runs .github/workflows/npm.yml, which builds, tests, packs and smoke-tests @tinyactors/sxml from the tag (tools/npm-package.sh) and stages it on npm with trusted publishing; a maintainer approves it with 2FA.

body.p: Recorded 2026-11-26 at the owner's word ("we need a release step for this"). Release 0.2.0 was tagged and its GitHub release carries the sxml archives, but step 7 of , publishing the JavaScript package by hand, was never done: a user found that @tinyactors/sxml, which the website shows as an import, returns 404 on npm, and used the released command instead.

item.p: The step is a script. tools/npm-package.sh pack TAG (mise run npm:pack) builds the package from the tagged commit in a git worktree under build/npm/TAG/, so the script of main can build an older tag. It checks that the tag, version.h, package.json and package-lock.json name one version; builds the wasm preset; runs npm ci and the package's tests (ctest javascript/*, the size budget and the types included); builds dist/; packs the tarball and checks its files; and installs it into an empty project that imports the package by its name and evaluates an XPath expression.

A workflow runs it on the tag. .github/workflows/npm.yml runs on a pushed v* tag, or by hand with a tag, and calls tools/npm-package.sh publish TAG: the same checks, then npm stage publish with npm's trusted publishing (OIDC: no npm token exists; npm attaches provenance). A version npm has already is skipped, so a run can be repeated. A prerelease version goes to the dist-tag of its first identifier, never latest. The script refuses to publish outside GitHub Actions.
A maintainer approves each version with 2FA (npmjs.com, Staged Packages; or npm stage approve), as the other tinyactors packages do.
It is not CI. stands: nothing runs on pushes to main. This workflow runs only for a release tag.

The first version is published by hand. npm sets up a trusted publisher only for a package that exists. So the owner publishes 0.2.0 once from a terminal (mise run npm:pack -- v0.2.0, then npm stage publish in build/npm/v0.2.0/source/bindings/javascript, then approve it), then names tinyactors-dev/sxml and npm.yml as the package's trusted publisher with staged publishing allowed. Later releases need only the tag. The package names its repository in package.json, as npm's trusted publishing requires.
